title: Apply electric power formulas

hook.scenario: Dukaan par aap `9 W` ka LED bulb maangte hain.
hook.question: Is `9 W` ka actual physics mein matlab kya hota hai?

mental_model.intuition: Power matlab speed of consuming energy. Jiski power zyada, wo utni tezi se bijli khaayega.
mental_model.description: Rate at which electric energy is consumed is called electric power. `9 W` bulb ka matlab hai wo har second `9 J` energy use kar raha hai.

explanation:
Electric power ko `P` se likhte hain. Iska basic formula `P = V I` hai, jahan `V` voltage hai aur `I` current hai.

Agar humein `V` nahi pata aur `R` pata hai, toh Ohm's law (`V = I R`) use karke:

    P = (I R) * I
    P = I^2 R

Yeh formula tab best hai jab current (`I`) aur resistance (`R`) pata ho (jaise series circuits mein).

Aur agar humein `I` nahi pata, toh `I = V / R` use karke:

    P = V * (V / R)
    P = V^2 / R

Yeh formula appliances ke liye bahut useful hai kyunki gharon mein `V` (`220 V`) constant (parallel) rehta hai.

Power ki SI unit Watt (`W`) hai. Commercial bijli ka bill nikalne ke liye unit 'kilowatt-hour' (`kWh`) hoti hai. `1 kWh` ka matlab hai `1 kW` (`1000 W`) ka appliance `1` ghante tak chala. `1 kWh = 3.6 x 10^6 J`.

key_points.title: Three Formulas
key_points.detail: `P = V I`, `P = I^2 R`, and `P = V^2 / R`.

key_points.title: Commercial Unit
key_points.detail: `1 kWh = 3.6 x 10^6 J`. This is `1` 'Unit' on your electricity bill.

worked_example.problem: An electric bulb is connected to a `220 V` generator. The current is `0.50 A`. What is the power of the bulb?

steps.narration: `V` aur `I` dono directly diye gaye hain.
Power ka basic formula use karte hain.

worked_example.problem: An electric refrigerator rated `400 W` operates `8` hours/day. What is the cost of the energy to operate it for `30` days at Rs `3.00` per `kWh`?

steps.narration: Total energy `E = P t` nikalte hain. Power ko `kW` mein aur time ko hours mein rakhte hain.
Total time for `30` days calculate karte hain.
Cost nikalne ke liye rate se multiply karte hain.

common_mistakes.title: Confusing W with kWh
common_mistakes.explanation: Watt (`W`) Power ki unit hai, aur Kilowatt-hour (`kWh`) Energy ki. Inhe mix mat karna.

common_mistakes.title: Using wrong time unit for kWh
common_mistakes.explanation: `kWh` calculate karte time, time hamesha hours mein hona chahiye, seconds mein nahi.

recall_questions.q: What is the SI unit of power?
`1 kWh` is equal to how many Joules?
What is the formula for electric power in terms of resistance and current?

oa_questions.question: Two conducting wires of the same material and of equal lengths and equal diameters are first connected in series and then parallel in a circuit across the same potential difference. The ratio of heat produced in series and parallel combinations would be?
oa_questions.approach: Use `P = V^2 / R`. In series, `R_s = 2 R`. In parallel, `R_p = R / 2`. Ratio = `(V^2 / 2 R) / (V^2 / (R / 2)) = 1/4`.

oa_questions.question: An electric heater is rated `1500 W`. How much energy does it use in `10` hours?
oa_questions.approach: Energy = Power * time = `1.5 kW * 10 h` = `15 kWh`.
